description: Use whenever the user says "make this a live artifact", "make my [thing] a live artifact", "add file upload to my artifact", "add a zip import suite", "let me upload PDFs/docx/spreadsheets to this" — even if "live artifact" isn't said and an HTML file is just attached with a ship/persist instruction. Also triggers on: add PDF/DOCX/XLSX parsing to an artifact, batch zip import, keep the artifact self-contained (no CDN), smoke-test an artifact before shipping, headless Playwright check on an HTML artifact. Not for scaffolding a new React/shadcn artifact from scratch (use web-artifacts-builder) or FlashFusion dashboards (use building-flashfusion-live-artifacts).
